SOURCE_JSON {"root": "/data/chenyiteng/projects/rlinf-shenzhen/worktrees/pi0-dvac-grpo-current", "rel": "rlinf/algorithms/advantages.py", "sha256": "a324ac98794fe9fcb1d2df3186ef1865c03cd2b06029aa3b4ffc03ab2059e791", "text": "# Copyright 2025 The RLinf Authors.\n#\n# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the \"License\");\n# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.\n# You may obtain a copy of the License at\n#\n#     https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0\n#\n# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software\n# distributed under the License is distributed on an \"AS IS\" BASIS,\n# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.\n# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and\n# limitations under the License.\n\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nimport torch\n\nfrom rlinf.algorithms.registry import register_advantage\nfrom rlinf.algorithms.utils import kl_penalty, safe_normalize\nfrom rlinf.utils.utils import masked_mean\n\n\n@register_advantage(\"gae\")\ndef compute_gae_advantages_and_returns(\n    rewards: torch.Tensor,\n    gamma: float = 1.0,\n    gae_lambda: float = 1.0,\n    values: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    normalize_advantages: bool = True,\n    normalize_returns: bool = False,\n    loss_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    dones: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    **kwargs,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Calculate advantages and returns for Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).\n    NOTE: currently this function does not support auto-reset.\n\n    This function implements Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) to compute\n    advantages and returns for PPO training. The advantages are normalized\n    using mean and standard deviation for stable training.\n\n    Args:\n        rewards (torch.Tensor): Rewards per timestep. Shape: [seq_len, bsz].\n        values (torch.Tensor): Value function estimates. Shape: [seq_len, bsz].\n        dones (torch.Tensor): Done flags (1 if episode ended, else 0).\n        gamma (float, optional): Discount factor. Defaults to 1.0.\n        gae_lambda (float, optional): GAE smoothing factor. Defaults to 1.0.\n        normalize_advantages (bool, optional): Whether to normalize advantages. Defaults to True.\n        normalize_returns (bool, optional): Whether to normalize returns. Defaults to False.\n\n    Returns:\n        Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: (advantages, returns)\n    \"\"\"\n    T = rewards.shape[0]\n    advantages = torch.zeros_like(rewards)\n    returns = torch.zeros_like(rewards)\n    gae = 0\n\n    critic_free = values is None\n    if critic_free:\n        gae_lambda = 1\n        gamma = 1\n\n    for step in reversed(range(T)):\n        if critic_free:\n            delta = rewards[step]\n        else:\n            delta = (\n                rewards[step]\n                + gamma * values[step + 1] * (~dones[step + 1])\n                - values[step]\n            )\n\n        gae = delta + gamma * gae_lambda * (~dones[step + 1]) * gae\n        returns[step] = gae if critic_free else gae + values[step]\n\n    advantages = returns - values[:-1] if not critic_free else returns\n\n    if normalize_advantages:\n        advantages = safe_normalize(advantages, loss_mask=loss_mask)\n    if normalize_returns:\n        returns = safe_normalize(returns, loss_mask=loss_mask)\n\n    return advantages, returns\n\n\n@register_advantage(\"grpo\")\ndef compute_grpo_advantages(\n    rewards: torch.Tensor,\n    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,\n    group_size: int,\n    **kwargs,\n):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute GRPO advantages.\n\n    Args:\n        rewards (torch.Tensor): Reward or score values. Shape: [num_groups, group_size]\n        loss_mask (torch.Tensor): Loss mask for valid entries. Shape: [num_groups, group_size]\n        group_size (int): Group size for advantage computation.\n\n    Returns:\n        torch.Tensor: advantages\n    \"\"\"\n    grouped_rewards = rewards.view(-1, group_size)\n\n    grouped_reward_mean = grouped_rewards.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True).expand_as(\n        grouped_rewards\n    )\n    grouped_reward_std = grouped_rewards.std(dim=-1, keepdim=True).expand_as(\n        grouped_rewards\n    )\n\n    advantages = grouped_rewards - grouped_reward_mean\n    advantages = advantages / (grouped_reward_std + 1e-6)\n\n    advantages = (torch.zeros_like(loss_mask) + advantages.view(1, -1)) * loss_mask\n\n    return advantages, None\n\n\n@register_advantage(\"grpo_video\")\ndef compute_grpo_video_advantages(\n    rewards: torch.Tensor,\n    loss_mask: torch.Tensor,\n    group_size: int,\n    **kwargs,\n):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute fine-grained GRPO advantages for video frame/chunk rewards.\n\n    After embodied preprocessing, action-level video rewards have shape\n    [num_steps, batch_size], where num_steps is usually the number of decoded\n    frame chunks and batch_size is ordered as [num_prompts * group_size]. This\n    function reshapes rewards to [num_steps, num_prompts, group_size] and returns\n    advantages with the same [num_steps, batch_size] shape, so each frame/chunk\n    can receive its own credit signal.\n\n    advantage_mode=\"frame\":\n        Normalize each frame/chunk independently over the group_size samples.\n        Frame 0 only competes with frame 0 from other samples of the same prompt;\n        frame 1 only competes with frame 1, and so on.\n\n    advantage_mode=\"video\":\n        Normalize all frame/chunk rewards within the same prompt group together\n        over dimensions [num_steps, group_size]. Aggregate turn rewards into per-trajectory rewards first.\n        trajectory_rewards = torch.zeros(\n            num_trajectories, dtype=rewards.dtype, device=rewards.device\n        )\n        trajectory_counts = torch.zeros(\n            num_trajectories, dtype=torch.long, device=rewards.device\n        )\n\n        for turn_idx, traj_idx in enumerate(idx_to_traj):\n            trajectory_rewards[traj_idx] += rewards_flat[turn_idx]\n            trajectory_counts[traj_idx] += 1\n\n        # Step 1: Average rewards per trajectory.\n        trajectory_rewards = trajectory_rewards / trajectory_counts.clamp(min=1).float()\n\n        # Step 2: reshape to [num_questions, group_size] for per-question GRPO.\n        trajectory_rewards_grouped = trajectory_rewards.view(num_questions, group_size)\n\n        # [num_questions, 1]\n\n        # Step 4: normalize within each question group.\n        normalized_trajectory_rewards = (\n            trajectory_rewards_grouped - per_question_mean\n        ) / (per_question_std + 1e-6)  # Step 1: map each turn to its owning question.\n        turn_to_question = torch.tensor(\n            [idx_to_traj[i] // group_size for i in range(num_sequence)],\n            dtype=torch.long,\n            device=rewards.device,\n        )\n\n        # Step 2: normalize turn rewards within each question group.\n        for question_idx in range(num_questions):\n            question_mask = turn_to_question == question_idx\n            question_turn_rewards = rewards_flat[question_mask]\n\n            # 1 - eos_positions  # [1, B]\n\n    r_matrix = r_matrix.scatter_(dim=0, index=eos_indices, src=rewards)  # [L, B]\n\n    # add kl penalty\n    if kl_beta > 0:\n        kld = kl_penalty(logprob, ref_logprob, kl_penalty=kl_penalty_type)  # [L, B]\n        r_matrix -= kl_beta * kld\n\n    # compute return\n    ret_matrix = torch.cumsum(r_matrix.flip(dims=[0]), dim=0).flip(dims=[0])\n\n    # normalize\n    advantages = ret_matrix.clone()\n\n    mean = masked_mean(advantages, loss_mask)\n    var = masked_mean((advantages - Shape: [num_groups, group_size]\n        loss_mask (torch.Tensor): Loss mask for valid entries. Shape: [num_groups, group_size]\n        normalize_advantages (bool): Whether to normalize advantages.\n\n    Returns:\n        torch.Tensor: advantages\n    \"\"\"\n    if rewards.ndim == 2:\n        rewards = rewards.reshape(-1)\n    advantages = rewards.unsqueeze(0).expand_as(loss_mask) * loss_mask\n\n    # Simple baseline subtraction (mean of valid advantages)\n    if normalize_advantages:\n        valid = advantages[loss_mask.bool()]\n        if valid.numel() > 0:\n            advantages = (advantages - valid.mean()) / (valid.std() + 1e-5)\n\n    return advantages, None\n"}

0)\n\n    if critic_warmup:\n        policy_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=policy_loss.device)\n\n    # Compile metrics for logging\n    loss_mask_for_metrics = loss_mask\n    ratio_for_metrics = ratio.detach()\n    ratio_abs_for_metrics = (ratio - 1).abs().detach()\n    clipped_ratio_for_metrics = clipped_ratio.detach()\n    dual_cliped_ratio_for_metrics = dual_cliped_ratio.detach()\n\n    # Only broadcast when ratio has action_dim dimension and loss_mask's last dim is 1\n    # This handles token_level mode: ratio [bsz, num_chunks, action_dim], loss_mask [bsz, num_chunks, 1]\n    if len(ratio.shape) > 2 and loss_mask.shape[-1] == 1 and ratio.shape[-1] > 1:\n        # Broadcast loss_mask to match ratio's shape for metrics computation\n        loss_mask_for_metrics = loss_mask.expand_as(ratio)\n\n    metrics_data = {\n        \"actor/policy_loss\": policy_loss.detach(),\n        \"actor/policy_loss_abs\": metric_policy_loss_abs.detach(),\n        \"actor/ratio\": masked_mean(ratio_for_metrics, loss_mask_for_metrics),\n        \"actor/ratio_abs\": masked_mean(ratio_abs_for_metrics, loss_mask_for_metrics),\n        \"actor/clipped_ratio\": masked_mean(\n            clipped_ratio_for_metrics, loss_mask_for_metrics\n        ),\n        \"actor/dual_cliped_ratio\": masked_mean(\n            dual_cliped_ratio_for_metrics, loss_mask_for_metrics\n        ),\n torch.Tensor,\n    returns: torch.Tensor,\n    prev_values: torch.Tensor,\n    value_clip: float,\n    huber_delta: float,\n    loss_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    max_episode_steps: Optional[int] = None,\n    loss_mask_sum: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    **kwargs,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute PPO critic loss function.\n\n    Args:\n        values (torch.Tensor): Current value predictions.\n        returns (torch.Tensor): Return values.\n        prev_values (torch.Tensor): Previous value predictions.\n        value_clip (float): Value clipping threshold.\n        huber_delta (float): Huber loss delta parameter.\n\n    Returns:\n        Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict]: (critic_loss, metrics_dict)\n    \"\"\"\n    loss_mask_ratio = None\n    loss_agg_func = masked_mean\n\n    if (\n        max_episode_steps is not None\n        and loss_mask_sum is not None\n        and loss_mask is not None\n    ):\n        loss_mask_ratio = (loss_mask_sum * 1.0) / max_episode_steps\n        loss_agg_func = masked_mean_ratio\n\n    value_pred_clipped = prev_values + (values - prev_values).clamp(\n        -value_clip, value_clip\n    )  # [bsz, ] | [bsz, chunk-step]\n\n    value_loss_original = huber_loss(\n        returns - values, huber_delta\n    )  # [bsz, ] | [bsz, chunk-step]\n    value_loss_clipped = huber_loss(\n        returns - value_pred_clipped, huber_delta\n    )  # [bsz, ] | [bsz, chunk-step]\n    value_loss = torch.max(value_loss_original, value_loss_clipped)\n    value_loss = loss_agg_func(value_loss, loss_mask, loss_mask_ratio)\n\n    value_clip_indicator = (value_pred_clipped - prev_values).abs() > value_clip\n    value_clip_ratio = value_clip_indicator.float().mean()\n\n    explained_variance_stats = compute_critic_explained_variance_stats(\n        returns=returns,\n        values=values,\n        loss_mask=loss_mask,\n    )\n\n    # Compile metrics for logging\n    metrics_data = {\n        \"critic/value_loss\": value_loss.detach(),\n        \"critic/value_clip_ratio\": value_clip_ratio.detach(),\n    }\n    metrics_data.update(\n        {key: value.detach() for key, value in explained_variance_stats.items()}\n    )\n    return value_loss, metrics_data\n\n\n@register_policy_loss(\"decoupled_actor_critic\")\ndef compute_decoupled_ppo_actor_critic_loss(**kwargs) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute decoupled PPO actor+critic loss.\"\"\"\n    metrics_data = {}\n    actor_loss, actor_metrics_data = compute_decoupled_ppo_actor_loss(**kwargs)\n    return loss, metrics_data\n\n\n@register_policy_loss(\"actor_critic\")\ndef compute_ppo_actor_critic_loss(**kwargs) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute PPO actor loss Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n    **kwargs,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict]:\n    \"\"\"Compute the VLA-OPD actor loss with stop-gradient dense rewards.\"\"\"\n    assert logprobs.dtype ==           input_channel: The input channel to read from.\n            output_channel: The output channel to send results to.\n            compute_ref_logprobs: Whether to compute reference logprobs.\n total_result_len_per_dp, (\n            f\"Expected {total_result_len_per_dp} sequences from channel, but got {total_result_len}\"\n        )\n\n    @Worker.timer(\"training_step\")\n    def            (recomputed_logprobs - rollout_logprobs).exp(),\n                    max=self.cfg.algorithm.importance_sampling_clip,\n                )\n\n            loss, mbs_metrics_data = _infer_rollout_batch_size(data: Any) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Infer batch dim for routed shards; supports PolicyOutput and plain tensor payloads.\n\n        When the channel carries a   observation: _model.Observation,\n        noise=None,\n        mode=\"train\",\n        compute_values=True,\n        return_dvac_telemetry: bool = False,\n    ) -> torch.Tensor:\n        \"\"\"Do a      self,\n        state,\n        prefix_output,\n        prefix_pad_masks,\n        past_key_values,\n        noise=None,\n        mode=\"train\",\n        compute_values=True,\n        return_dvac_telemetry: bool = False,\n    ) -> torch.Tensor:\n        bsize = state.shape[0]\n        device = state.device\n        num_steps = self.config.num_steps\n        if noise is None:\n            actions_shape = (bsize, self.config.action_horizon, self.config.action_dim)\n            noise = self.sample_noise(actions_shape, device)\n        else:\n            # DSRL: SAC provides noise, convert dtype to match action_in_proj\n            noise = noise.to(self.action_in_proj.weight.dtype)\n\n        x_t = noise\n        # add sde sample and traj collect\n        chains = []\n        log_probs = []\n        values = []\n        chains.append(x_t)\n        endpoint_trace = [] if return_dvac_telemetry else None\n        telemetry_timesteps = (\n            self._get_timesteps(num_steps, device) if return_dvac_telemetry else None\n        )\n\n        # add value based on the vlm for pi05, expert for pi0\n        if self.use_vlm_value:\n            values_vlm = self.get_value_from_vlm(prefix_output)\n        if self.config.joint_logprob:\n            initial_log_prob = self.get_logprob_norm(\n                x_t, torch.zeros_like(noise), torch.ones_like(noise)\n            )\n            log_probs.append(initial_log_prob)\n\n        # In the joint logprob mode, we need to sample the logprob for each denoise step\n        # In the non-joint logprob mode, only one denoise step is sampled and ode-sde mix sampling is used\n        # denoise index\n        collect_nft_state = self.config.is_nft and mode == \"train\"\n        if mode == \"train\":\n            if self.config.joint_logprob or collect_nft_state:\n                denoise_inds = torch.arange(num_steps)\n            else:\n                if self.config.ignore_last:\n                    denoise_inds = torch.tensor(\n                        [random.randint(0, num_steps - 2)] * num_steps\n                    )\n                else:\n                    denoise_inds = torch.tensor(\n                        [random.randint(0, num_steps - 1)] * num_steps\n                    )\n        else:\n            denoise_inds = torch.tensor([-1] * num_steps)\n        denoise_inds = denoise_inds[None].repeat(bsize, 1)\n\n        # collect nft states for nft algorithm\n        nft_state = self._init_nft_state(collect_nft_state, x_t, num_steps, device)\n\n        # denoise step\n        for idx in range(num_steps):\n            # sample mean var val\n            if idx == denoise_inds[0][idx]:\n                sample_method = self.config.noise_method\n            else:\n                sample_method = \"flow_ode\"\n            x_t_prev = x_t\n            x_t_mean, x_t_std, value_t, v_t = self.sample_mean_var_val(\n                x_t,\n                idx,\n                state,\n                prefix_pad_masks,\n                past_key_values,\n                sample_method,\n                num_steps,\n                compute_values,\n            )\n            if endpoint_trace is not None:\n                t_i = telemetry_timesteps[idx].to(dtype=x_t_prev.dtype)\n                endpoint_trace.append(\n                    (x_t_prev - v_t * t_i)[..., : self.config.action_env_dim].detach()\n                )\n            # Euler step - use new tensor assignment instead of in-place operation\n            x_t = x_t_mean + self.sample_noise(x_t.shape, device) * x_t_std\n            self._update_nft_state(nft_state, idx, x_t_prev, v_t, x_t, sample_method)\n            log_prob = self.get_logprob_norm(x_t, x_t_mean, x_t_std)\n            # store\n            values.append(value_t)\n            chains.append(x_t)\n            log_probs.append(log_prob)\n        x_0 = x_t\n        chains = torch.stack(chains, dim=1)\n        # post process for logprob\n        log_probs = torch.stack(log_probs, dim=1)[\n            :, :, : self.config.action_chunk, : self.config.action_env_dim\n        ]\n        if self.config.joint_logprob:\n            log_probs = log_probs.mean(dim=1)\n        else:\n            log_probs = log_probs[\n                torch.arange(log_probs.shape[0],    values = torch.stack(values, dim=1).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)\n        result = {\n            \"actions\": x_0,\n            \"chains\": chains,\n            \"prev_logprobs\": log_probs,\n            \"prev_values\": values,\n            \"denoise_inds\": denoise_inds,\n        }\n        if collect_nft_state:\n            result.update(nft_state)\n            result[\"nft_x0\"] = self.config.action_env_dim].detach(),\n            }\n        return result\n\n    def _get_timesteps(self, denoise_steps, device):\n        timesteps = torch.linspace(1, 1 / denoise_steps, denoise_steps, device=device)\n        timesteps = torch.cat([timesteps, torch.zeros((1), device=device)])\n        return timesteps\n\n    def sample_mean_var_val(\n        self,\n        x_t,\n        idx,\n        state,\n        prefix_pad_masks,\n        past_key_values,\n        sample_method,\n        denoise_steps,\n        compute_values=True,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Sample the mean, variance and value of the action at a given timestep.\n        Rollout sample (idx is int) and actor get_log_prob_value (idx is tensor)\n        will load this function. `sample_method` is one of flow_ode/flow_sde/\n        flow_cps/flow_noise.\n        \"\"\"\n        # expand the shape\n        bsize = state.shape[0]\n        device = state.device\n        if isinstance(idx, int):\n            idx = torch.full((), idx, device=device).expand(bsize)\n        # build parameters\n        noise_level = self._get_noise_level(device=device, dtype=x_t.dtype)\n        timesteps = self._get_timesteps(denoise_steps, device)\n        # input parameters\n        t_input = timesteps[idx]\n        delta = timesteps[idx] - timesteps[idx + 1]\n        # velocity prediction\n        v_t, suffix_out = self.get_velocity(\n            state, x_t, t_input, prefix_pad_masks, past_key_values\n        )\n        # value prediction\n        if (\n            self.config.add_value_head\n            and compute_values\n            and not self.config.value_after_vlm\n        ):\n            value_t = self._compute_value_from_suffix(suffix_out)\n        else:\n            value_t = torch.zeros((bsize), device=device)\n        # sample mean and variance\n        delta = delta[:, None, None].expand_as(x_t)\n        t_input = t_input[:, None, None].expand_as(x_t)\n        x0_pred = x_t - v_t * t_input\n        x1_pred = x_t + v_t * (1 - t_input)\n\n        if sample_method == \"flow_ode\":\n            x0_weight = 1 - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = t_input - delta\n            x_t_std = torch.zeros_like(t_input)\n        elif sample_method == \"flow_sde\":\n            denom_timesteps = torch.where(timesteps == 1, timesteps[1], timesteps)\n            sigma_ratio = timesteps / (1 - denom_timesteps)\n            sigmas = noise_level * torch.sqrt(sigma_ratio)[:-1]\n            sigma_i = sigmas[idx][:, None, None].expand_as(x_t)\n            x0_weight = torch.ones_like(t_input) - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = t_input - delta - sigma_i**2 * delta / (2 * t_input)\n            x_t_std = torch.sqrt(delta) * sigma_i\n        elif sample_method == \"flow_cps\":\n            pi = torch.pi\n            cos_term = torch.cos(pi * noise_level / 2).to(device)\n            sin_term = torch.sin(pi * noise_level / 2).to(device)\n            x0_weight = torch.ones_like(t_input) - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = (t_input - delta) * cos_term\n            x_t_std = (t_input - delta) * sin_term\n        elif sample_method == \"flow_noise\":\n            x0_weight = 1 - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = t_input - delta\n            x_t_std = self.noise_head(suffix_out)\n        else:\n            raise ValueError(f\"Invalid noise method: {sample_method}\")\n        x_t_mean = x0_pred * x0_weight + x1_pred * x1_weight\n        return x_t_mean, x_t_std, value_t, v_t\n\n    def get_suffix_out(\n        self,\n        state,\n        prefix_pad_masks,\n        past_key_values,\n        x_t,\n        timestep,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Apply one denoising step of the noise `x_t` at a given timestep.\"\"\"\n        suffix_embs, suffix_pad_masks, suffix_att_masks, adarms_cond = (\n            self.embed_suffix(state, x_t, timestep)\n        )\n\n        suffix_len = suffix_pad_masks.shape[1]\n        batch_size = prefix_pad_masks.shape[0]\n        prefix_len = prefix_pad_masks.shape[1]\n\n        prefix_pad_2d_masks = prefix_pad_masks[:, None, :].expand(\n            batch_size, suffix_len, prefix_len\n        )\n\n        suffix_att_2d_masks = make_att_2d_masks(suffix_pad_masks, suffix_att_masks)\n\n        full_att_2d_masks = torch.cat([prefix_pad_2d_masks, Prepare attention masks\n        full_att_2d_masks_4d = self._prepare_attention_masks_4d(full_att_2d_masks)\n        self.paligemma_with_expert.gemma_expert.model.config._attn_implementation = (\n            \"eager\"  # noqa: SLF001\n        )\n\n        outputs_embeds, _ = self.paligemma_with_expert.forward(\n            attention_mask=full_att_2d_masks_4d,\n            position_ids=position_ids,\n            past_key_values=past_key_values,\n            inputs_embeds=[None, suffix_embs],\n            use_cache=False,\n            adarms_cond=[None, adarms_cond],\n        )\n\n        suffix_out = outputs_embeds[1]\n        suffix_out = suffix_out[:, -self.config.action_horizon :]\n        suffix_out = suffix_out.to(dtype=torch.float32)\n        return def _build_prefix_cache(self, images, img_masks, lang_tokens, lang_masks):\n        \"\"\"Embed prefix tokens and compute KV cache for efficient suffix generation.\"\"\"\n        prefix_embs, self.paligemma_with_expert.paligemma.language_model.config._attn_implementation = \"eager\"  # noqa: SLF001\n        (prefix_output, _), past_key_values = self.paligemma_with_expert.forward(\n      )\n        else:\n            suffix_out_value = torch.mean(suffix_out, dim=1, keepdim=False)\n        if self.config.detach_critic_input:\n            suffix_out_value = log p(x|mu,sigma) = -log(sigma) - 0.5 * log(2 * pi) - 0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma) ** 2\n        if self.config.safe_get_logprob:\n            log_prob = -torch.pow((sample - mu), 2)\n        else:\n            mask = sigma == 0\n            sigma_safe = torch.where(mask, torch.ones_like(sigma), sigma)\n            constant_term = -torch.log(sigma_safe) - 0.5 * torch.log(\n                2 * torch.pi * torch.ones_like(sample)\n            )\n            exponent_term = -0.5 * torch.pow((sample - mu) / sigma_safe, 2)\n            log_prob = constant_term + exponent_term\n            log_prob = torch.where(mask, torch.zeros_like(log_prob), log_prob)\n        return log_prob\n\n    def preprocess_for_train(self, data):\n        return data\n\n    def get_log_prob_value(\n        self,\n        images,\n        img_masks,\n        lang_tokens,\n        lang_masks,\n        state,\n        chains,\n        denoise_inds,\n        compute_values=False,\n    ):\n        bsize = state.shape[0]\n        batch_indices = torch.arange(bsize)\n        prefix_output, prefix_pad_masks, past_key_values = self._build_prefix_cache(\n            images, img_masks, lang_tokens, lang_masks\n        )\n        initial_log_prob = self.get_logprob_norm(\n                chains[:, 0],\n                torch.zeros_like(chains[:, 0]),\n                torch.ones_like(chains[:, 0]),\n            )\n            initial_entropy = self.gaussian_entropy(torch.ones_like(chains[:, 0]))\n            chains_log_probs.append(initial_log_prob)\n            chains_entropy.append(initial_entropy)\n        else:\n            num_steps = 1\n        for idx in range(num_steps):\n            denoise_ind = denoise_inds[:, idx]\n            chains_pre = chains[batch_indices, denoise_ind]\n            chains_next = chains[batch_indices, denoise_ind + 1]\n            x_t_mean, x_t_std, value_t, _ = self.sample_mean_var_val(\n                chains_pre,\n                denoise_ind,\n                state,\n                prefix_pad_masks,\n                past_key_values,\n                self.config.noise_method,\n                self.config.num_steps,\n                compute_values,\n            )\n            log_probs = self.get_logprob_norm(chains_next, x_t_mean, x_t_std)\n            entropy = self.gaussian_entropy(x_t_std)\n            chains_log_probs.append(log_probs)\n            chains_entropy.append(entropy)\n            if not self.use_vlm_value:\n                chains_values.append(value_t)\n        if self.use_vlm_value:\n            chains_values.append(self.get_value_from_vlm(prefix_output))\n        chains_log_probs = torch.stack(chains_log_probs, dim=1)\n        chains_values = torch.stack(chains_values, dim=1)\n\n        # chains_entropy = torch.zeros_like(chains_log_probs)\n        return chains_log_probs, chains_values, chains_entropy\n\n    def get_value_from_vlm(self, prefix_output):\n        # prefix_output:\n        # pi05: [bs, (256 * 3 + 200) = 968, 2048]\n        # pi0: [bs, (256 * 3 + 48) = 816, 1024]\n        # token length\n        if \"pi05_\" in self.config.config_name:\n            lang_token_len = 200\n            all_token_length = 968\n        elif \"pi0_\" in self.config.config_name:\n            lang_token_len = 48\n            all_token_length = 816\n\n        if self.config.value_vlm_mode math.pi * math.e * (sigma_safe**2))\n        return entropy\n\n    def freeze_vlm(self):\n        if self.config.train_expert_only:\n            # Base freeze: paligemma (SigLIP vision encoder + \"action_in_proj\",\n                        \"action_out_proj\",\n                        \"time_mlp_in\",\n                        \"time_mlp_out\",\n                    ]\n                else:\n                    projection_names = [\n                        \"action_in_proj\",\n                        \"action_out_proj\",\n                        \"state_proj\",\n                        \"action_time_mlp\",\n                    ]\n                frozen_count = 0\n                for name, param in self.named_parameters():\n                    if any(proj_name in name for proj_name                         self.logger.info(f\"  Froze: {name}\")\n                if frozen_count > 10:\n                    self.logger.info(\n                        f\"  ... and {frozen_count - 10}                        f\"  Froze {noise_net_params:,} parameters in reinflow_explore_noise_net\"\n                    )\n\n    # ===== DSRL-specific methods =====\n\n    def sac_forward(\n        self, obs=None, data=None, train=False, return_dist_params=False, **kwargs\n    ):\n        \"\"\"SAC forward pass for DSRL.\n\n        Args:\n            obs: Observation dict (preferred, matches sac_dsrl).\n                 Supports two formats:\n                   1. {\"images\": list of tensors, \"states\": tensor} - internal format\n                   2. {\"main_images\": tensor, \"wrist_images\": tensor, \"states\": tensor} - env format\n            data: Dictionary containing observations (legacy, for backward compatibility).\n            train: Whether to use data augmentation.\n            return_dist_params: Whether to return distribution parameters for logging.\n\n        Returns:\n            actions: [B, action_horizon, output_dim] - noise or actual actions\n            logprobs: [B] - log probabilities\n            dist_params: (mean, std) or None - distribution parameters for logging\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.config.use_dsrl:\n            raise ValueError(\"sac_forward called but use_dsrl=False\")\n\n        # Support both call styles: obs (new, from sac_dsrl) or data (legacy)\n        if obs is None:\n            obs = data.get(\"obs\", data) if data is not None else kwargs.get(\"obs\", {})\n\n        # Handle two obs formats:\n        # Format 1 (internal): {\"images\": [...], \"states\": ...}\n        # Format 2 (env): {\"main_images\": ..., \"wrist_images\": ..., \"states\": ...}\n        if \"images\" not in obs:\n            # Convert env format to internal format\n            if \"main_images\" in obs:\n                obs = {\"images\": [obs[\"main_images\"]], \"states\": obs[\"states\"]}\n            else:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f\"Invalid obs format: {obs.keys()}. Expected 'images' or 'main_images' key.\"\n                )\n\n        # Preprocess images: resize to 64x64, use only agentview camera\n        # Returns [B, 1, C, 64, 64] in [-1, 1] range (float32)\n        images = self._preprocess_dsrl_images(obs[\"images\"], train=train)\n        states = self._preprocess_states(obs[\"states\"])\n\n        # Move to the same device as actor encoders, convert to bfloat16\n        device = next(self.actor_image_encoder.parameters()).device\n        images = images.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n        states = states.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)\n\n        # Extract features (using actor's independent encoder)\n        image_features = self.actor_image_encoder(images)  # [B, 64]\n        state_features = self.actor_state_encoder(states)  # [B, 64]\n        features = torch.cat([state_features, image_features], dim=-1)  # [B, 128]\n\n        # Sample from GaussianPolicy\n        mode = kwargs.get(\"mode\", \"train\")\n        deterministic = mode == \"eval\"\n\n        action_noise, logprobs = self.dsrl_action_noise_net.sample(\n            features, deterministic=deterministic\n        )\n\n        # Optional: return distribution parameters for logging\n        dist_params = None\n        if return_dist_params:\n            dist = self.dsrl_action_noise_net.forward(features)\n            dist_params = (dist.mean, dist.stddev)\n\n        return action_noise, logprobs, dist_params\n\n    def sac_q_forward(\n        self,\n        obs=None,\n        data=None,\n        actions=None,\n        detach_encoder=False,\n        train=False,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"Q-value forward pass for DSRL.\n\n        Args:\n            obs: Observation dict (preferred, matches sac_dsrl).\n                 Supports two formats:\n                   1. {\"images\": list of tensors, \"states\": tensor} -            actions = actions[:, 0, :]  # [B, action_horizon, dim] -> [B, dim]\n\n        # Compute Q values\n        q_values = self.q_head(state_features, image_features, actions)\n\n        return q_values\n\n    # ===== NFT-specific methods =====\n\n    def _init_nft_state(\n        self,\n        collect_nft_state: bool,\n        x_t: torch.Tensor,\n        num_steps: int,\n        device: torch.device,\n    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None:\n        \"\"\"Initialize NFT state buffers for rollout sampling.\"\"\"\n        if not collect_nft_state:\n            return None\n       ),\n        }\n\n    def _update_nft_state(\n        self,\n        nft_state: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None,\n        idx: int,\n        x_t_prev: torch.Tensor,\n        v_t: torch.Tensor,\n        x_t: torch.Tensor,\n        sample_method: str,\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Update NFT state buffers for the selected denoising step.\"\"\"\n        if nft_state is None:\n            return\n        mask = nft_state[\"nft_step_index\"] == idx\n        if not mask.any():\n            return\n        mask_bc = mask[:, None, None]\n        nft_state[\"nft_xcur\"] = torch.where(\n            mask_bc, x_t_prev.detach(), nft_state[\"nft_xcur\"]\n        )\n        nft_state[\"nft_v\"] = torch.where(mask_bc, v_t.detach(), nft_state[\"nft_v\"])\n        nft_state[\"nft_xnext\"] = self.config.noise_anneal:\n            noise_start, noise_end, anneal_steps = self.config.noise_params\n            noise_level = (\n                noise_start\n                + (noise_end - noise_start)\n                * min(self.global_step, anneal_steps)\n                / anneal_steps\n            )\n        else:\n            noise_level = self.config.noise_level\n        return  For Libero: images[0] is agentview, images[1] is wrist.\n            train: Whether to use data augmentation (placeholder for now).\n\n        Returns:\n            Tensor of shape [B, 1, C, 64, 64] - only agentview, resized, in [-1, 1].\n        \"\"\"\n\n        # Extract only agentview camera (first image in the list)\n        if isinstance(images, list):\n            agentview_img = # [-1, 1] -> [0, 1]\n                agentview_img = (agentview_img + 1.0) / 2.0\n            # else: already in [0, 1] range, assume correctly normalized\n        # behavior) =====\n        # PyTorch bilinear with align_corners=False approximates PIL's behavior\n        resized_img = F.interpolate(\n            agentview_img,\n            size=(target_size, target_size),\n            mode=\"bilinear\",\n            align_corners=False,\n        )\n        # =============================================================\n\n        # Convert back to [-1, 1] Args:\n            states: [B, ...] any shape\n\n        Returns:\n            states: [B, state_dim] flattened states as bfloat16\n        \"\"\"\n        if states.dim() > 2:\n            states = self.paligemma_with_expert.paligemma.model.vision_tower.forward = torch.compile(\n            self.paligemma_with_expert.paligemma.model.vision_tower.forward, mode=mode\n        )\n\n        # NOTE: Shape: [num_groups, group_size]\n        normalize_advantages (bool): Whether to normalize advantages.\n\n    Returns:\n        torch.Tensor: advantages\n    \"\"\"\n    if rewards.ndim == 2:\n        rewards = rewards.reshape(-1)\n    advantages = rewards.unsqueeze(0).expand_as(loss_mask) * loss_mask\n\n    # Simple baseline subtraction (mean of valid advantages)\n    if normalize_advantages:\n        valid = advantages[loss_mask.bool()]\n        if valid.numel() > 0:\n            advantages = (advantages - valid.mean()) / (valid.std() + 1e-5)\n\n    return advantages, None\n"}

terminations, infos):\n        n_steps_to_run = np.array(\n            [[0] for i in range(self.num_envs)]\n        )  # infos.get(\"n_steps_to_run\", np.array([[0] for i in = reward\n                else:\n                    chunk_rewards[env_id, start_idx:] = reward\n\n        return chunk_rewards\n\n    def reset(\n        self,\n        env_idx: Optional[Union[int, self._extract_obs_image(raw_obs)\n\n        return extracted_obs, infos\n\n    def step(\n        self, actions: Union[torch.Tensor, np.ndarray, dict] = None, auto_reset=True\n    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, dict]:\n        if actions is None:\n            assert self._is_start, \"Actions must be provided after the first reset.\"\n\n        if isinstance(actions, torch.Tensor):\n            actions = actions.cpu().numpy()\n        elif isinstance(actions, dict):\n            actions = actions.get(\"actions\", actions)\n\n        # [n_envs, horizon, action_dim]\n        if len(actions.shape) == 2:\n            # [n_envs, action_dim] -> [n_envs, 1, action_dim]\n            actions = actions[:, None, :]\n\n        raw_obs, step_reward,     )\n\n        if self.use_custom_reward:\n            step_reward = self._calc_step_reward(terminations)\n        else:\n            if isinstance(step_reward, list):\n                step_reward = actions.shape[1]\n        truncated = self._elapsed_steps >= self.cfg.max_episode_steps\n        if truncated.any():\n            truncations = torch.logical_or(truncated, truncations)\n\n chunk_truncations[:, -1] = truncations\n\n        return (\n            obs_list,\n            chunk_rewards,\n            chunk_terminations,\n            chunk_truncations,\n np.random.randn(self.num_envs, self.horizon, 14)\n\n    def _init_reset_state_ids(self):\n        if self.cfg.get(\"seeds_path\", None) is not None and os.path.exists(\n            self.cfg.seeds_path\n        ):\n            with open(self.cfg.seeds_path, \"r\") as f:\n                data = json.load(f)\n            success_seeds = data[self.task_name].get(\"success_seeds\", None)\n            if success_seeds is not None:\n                success_seeds = torch.as_tensor(success_seeds, dtype=torch.long)\n                self.success_seeds = partition_success_seeds(\n self._generator = torch.Generator()\n            self._generator.manual_seed(self.seed)\n        self.update_reset_state_ids()\n\n    def update_reset_state_ids(self, env_idx=None):\n        if     + self._current_seed_index\n                ) % total_seeds\n                reset_state_ids = self.success_seeds[indices]\n                reset_state_ids = reset_state_ids.repeat_interleave(\n                    repeats=self.group_size\n                )\n                self._current_seed_index = (\n                    self._current_seed_index + self.num_group\n                ) % total_seeds\n            else:\n                reset_state_ids = torch.randint(\n                    low=10000,\n                    high=200000,\n                    size=(self.num_group,),\n                    generator=self._generator,\n                )\n                reset_state_ids = reset_state_ids.repeat_interleave(\n                    repeats=self.group_size\n                )\n            for idx in env_idx:\n                self.reset_state_ids[idx] = reset_state_ids[idx]\n        else:\n            if self.success_seeds is not None:\n                total_seeds =   idx,\n        state,\n        prefix_pad_masks,\n        past_key_values,\n        sample_method,\n        denoise_steps,\n        compute_values=True,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Sample the mean, variance and value of the action at a given timestep.\n        Rollout sample (idx is int) and actor get_log_prob_value (idx is tensor)\n        will load this function. `sample_method` is one of flow_ode/flow_sde/\n        flow_cps/flow_noise.\n        \"\"\"\n        # expand the shape\n        bsize = state.shape[0]\n        device = state.device\n        if isinstance(idx, int):\n            idx = torch.full((), idx, device=device).expand(bsize)\n        # build parameters\n        noise_level = self._get_noise_level(device=device, dtype=x_t.dtype)\n        timesteps = self._get_timesteps(denoise_steps, device)\n        # input parameters\n        t_input = timesteps[idx]\n        delta = timesteps[idx] - timesteps[idx + 1]\n        # velocity prediction\n x_t - v_t * t_input\n        x1_pred = x_t + v_t * (1 - t_input)\n\n        if sample_method == \"flow_ode\":\n            x0_weight = 1 - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = t_input - delta\n            x_t_std = torch.zeros_like(t_input)\n        elif sample_method == \"flow_sde\":\n            denom_timesteps = torch.where(timesteps == 1, timesteps[1], timesteps)\n            sigma_ratio torch.ones_like(t_input) - (t_input - delta)\n            x1_weight = t_input - delta - sigma_i**2 * delta / (2 * t_input)\n            x_t_std = torch.sqrt(delta) * sigma_i\n        elif log p(x|mu,sigma) = -log(sigma) - 0.5 * log(2 * pi) - 0.5 * ((x - mu) / sigma) ** 2\n        if self.config.safe_get_logprob:\n            log_prob = -torch.pow((sample - mu), 2)\n        else:\n            mask = sigma == 0\n            sigma_safe = torch.where(mask, torch.ones_like(sigma), sigma)\n            constant_term = -torch.log(sigma_safe) - 0.5 * torch.log(\n                2 * torch.pi * torch.ones_like(sample)\n            )\n            exponent_term = -0.5 * torch.pow((sample - mu) / sigma_safe, 2)\n            log_prob = constant_term + exponent_term\n            log_prob = torch.where(mask, torch.zeros_like(log_prob), log_prob)\n        return log_prob\n\n    def preprocess_for_train(self, data):\n        return data\n\n    def get_log_prob_value(\n        self,\n     log_probs = self.get_logprob_norm(chains_next, x_t_mean, x_t_std)\n            entropy = self.gaussian_entropy(x_t_std)\n            chains_log_probs.append(log_probs)\n   return values_vlm\n\n    def gaussian_entropy(self, sigma):\n        mask = sigma == 0\n        sigma_safe = torch.where(mask, torch.ones_like(sigma), sigma)\n        entropy = 0.5 * torch.log(2 * math.pi * math.e * (sigma_safe**2))\n        return entropy\n\n    def freeze_vlm(self):\n        if self.config.train_expert_only:\n            # Base freeze: paligemma (SigLIP vision encoder + self, obs=None, data=None, train=False, return_dist_params=False, **kwargs\n    ):\n        \"\"\"SAC forward pass for DSRL.\n\n        Args:\n            obs: Observation dict (preferred, matches augmentation.\n            return_dist_params: Whether to return distribution parameters for logging.\n\n        Returns:\n            actions: [B, action_horizon, output_dim] - noise or actual actions\n            logprobs: [B] - log probabilities\n            dist_params: (mean, std) or None - distribution parameters for logging\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.config.use_dsrl:\n            raise ValueError(\"sac_forward called but use_dsrl=False\")\n\n        # Support both call styles: obs (new, from sac_dsrl) or data (legacy)\n        if obs is None:\n            obs =      x_t: torch.Tensor,\n        sample_method: str,\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Update NFT state buffers for the selected denoising step.\"\"\"\n        if nft_state is None:\n            return\n def _setup_rollout_weight_dst_ranks(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Setup destination ranks for token and weight communication.\"\"\"\n        rank_map = RankMapper.get_actor_rank_to_rollout_rank_map(\n sync_model_to_inference(self) -> None:\n        \"\"\"\n        Sync the model's full state dict to the inference worker.\n        The model state_dict is the reference of actor's model\n tuple[dict[str, torch.Tensor], RolloutResult]:\n        result: RolloutResult = channel.get()\n\n        batch = result.to_actor_batch(\n            self.cfg.data.max_prompt_length,\n Channel,\n        min_result_len: int,\n        max_result_len: int,\n        cliped_results=[],\n        unfinished_result=None,\n    ):\n        assert not input_channel.is_local\n        rollout_results = cliped_results\n        # get min_result_len\n        while len(rollout_results) < min_result_len:\n            if unfinished_result is not None:\n                rollout_result: RolloutResult = unfinished_result.wait()\n                unfinished_result = None\n            else:\n                rollout_result: RolloutResult = input_channel.get()\n            rollout_results.append(rollout_result)\n\n        # try to get result as much\n        # get result in every 0.1s and do all reduce to get the min result between dp (result_len)\n        # stop at: the min result between dp (result_len) is same as the last min result\n        last_result_len = 0\n        result_len = len(rollout_results)\n        time_until = time.time() + 0.1\n        while last_result_len < result_len:\n            if len(rollout_results) < max_result_len:\n                if unfinished_result is None:\n                    unfinished_result = input_channel.get(async_op=True)\n                else:\n                    time.sleep(0.001)\n                if unfinished_result.done():\n                    rollout_results.append(unfinished_result.wait())\n                    unfinished_result = None\n                if time.time() >= time_until:\n                    last_result_len = result_len\n                    result_len = all_reduce_int(len(rollout_results))\n                    if last_result_len < result_len:\n                        time_until = time.time() + 0.1\n            else:\n                last_result_len = result_len\n                result_len = all_reduce_int(len(rollout_results))\n\n        cliped_results = list(rollout_results[result_len:])\n        rollout_results = rollout_results[:result_len]\n\n        batches = []\n        for rollout_result in rollout_results:\n            batch = rollout_result.to_actor_batch(\n                self.cfg.data.max_prompt_length,\n                self.cfg.actor.model.encoder_seq_length,\n                self.tokenizer.eos_token_id,\n            )\n            batches.append(batch)\n\n        batch = RolloutResult.merge_batches(batches)\n        rollout_result = RolloutResult.merge_result_list(rollout_results)\n        return batch, rollout_result, result_len, cliped_results, unfinished_result\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _split_to_micro_batch(\n        batch,\n        enable_dynamic_batch_size: bool,\n        *,\n        max_tokens_per_mbs: Optional[int] = None,\n using them before loading models\n        # Otherwise, it may lead to OOM\n        with self.device_lock:\n            if not self.enable_offload:\n                return\n            if forward_batch(\n        self, m_batch: dict[str, torch.Tensor], calculate_entropy: bool = False\n    ) -> torch.Tensor:\n        input_ids = m_batch[\"input_ids\"]\n        attention_mask = m_batch[\"attention_mask\"]\n        position_ids = m_batch[\"position_ids\"]\n\n        multi_modal_inputs = {}\n        if \"multi_modal_inputs\" in m_batch.keys():\n            for key in        input_ids=input_ids,\n                attention_mask=attention_mask,\n                position_ids=position_ids,\n                use_cache=False,\n                **multi_modal_inputs,\n            )\n\n        logits: torch.Tensor = outputs.logits\n\n        logits.div_(self.cfg.algorithm.sampling_params.temperature)\n\n        if self.enable_dynamic_batch_size or self,\n        batch: dict[str, torch.Tensor],\n        num_sequences: int,\n        compute_ref_logprobs: bool,\n    ):\n        micro_batches_iter, _, dbs_indices = self._split_to_micro_batch(\n            batch,\n            self.enable_dynamic_batch_size,\n            max_tokens_per_mbs=self.max_tokens_per_mbs,\n            split_num=num_sequences\n            //             get_reverse_idx(indices),\n                dtype=torch.long,\n            )\n        micro_batches = list(micro_batches_iter)\n\n        recomputed_logprobs, ref_logprobs = None, None\n\n        # Recompute logprobs\n        recomputed_logprobs = torch.cat(\n            [self.forward_batch(batch) for batch in micro_batches]\n        ).cpu()\n\n        if          assert self.ref_policy_state_dict is not None, (\n                \"Reference policy state dict is None but compute_ref_logprobs is True\"\n            )\n            with cpu_weight_swap(\n                self.model,\n                self.ref_policy_state_dict,\n                self.offload_model_buffer,\n            ):\n                ref_logprobs = torch.cat(\n        ref_logprobs = ref_logprobs[revert_indices]\n\n        return recomputed_logprobs, ref_logprobs\n\n    def run_inference(\n        self,\n        input_channel: Channel,\n        output_channel: Channel,\n        compute_ref_logprobs: bool,\n        do_offload=False,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Compute prev/ref logprobs using the actor Model's forward.\n\n        Args:\n            input_channel: The input channel to read from.\n            output_channel: The output channel to send results to.\n            compute_ref_logprobs: Whether to compute reference logprobs.\n            do_offload: Whether offload weights after inference is done\n        \"\"\"\n        assert not do_offload, (\n            \"do_offload argument of run_inference/run_training is not supported in FSDP for now\"\n        )\n\n        inference_split = self.cfg.actor.get(\"inference_split\", None)\n        if inference_split is None:\n            if not self.is_pipeline:\n                inference_split = 1\n            else:\n                inference_split = self.cfg.algorithm.n_minibatches\n        assert self.total_batch_size_per_dp % inference_split == 0, (\n            self.cfg.data.rollout_batch_size // self._world_size // inference_split\n        )\n        if not self.is_pipeline:\n            min_result_len = max_result_len\n            coll_rollout_results = []\n        total_result_len = 0\n        total_result_len_per_dp = self.cfg.data.rollout_batch_size // self._world_size\n        cliped_results, unfinished_result = [], None\n        while total_result_len < total_result_len_per_dp:\n            batch, rollout_result, result_len, cliped_results, unfinished_result = (\n                self.get_dynamic_batch_as_much(\n                    input_channel,\n                    min(min_result_len, total_result_len_per_dp - total_result_len),\n                    min(max_result_len, total_result_len_per_dp - total_result_len),\n                    cliped_results,\n                    unfinished_result,\n                )\n            )\n            total_result_len += result_len\n            self.log_debug(\n                f\"[dynamic inference rank-{self._rank}] inference result_len={result_len}, total_result_len={total_result_len}/{total_result_len_per_dp}\"\n            )\n            self._load_weight_and_optimizer()\n            self.model.eval()\n\n            with self.worker_timer():\n                with torch.no_grad():\n                    recomputed_logprobs, ref_logprobs RolloutResult.merge_result_list(coll_rollout_results)\n            split_results = RolloutResult.split_results(\n                rollout_result,\n                min(total_result_len, self.cfg.algorithm.n_minibatches),\n            )\n            for split_result in split_results:\n                output_channel.put(split_result)\n        assert total_result_len == total_result_len_per_dp, (\n            f\"Expected {total_result_len_per_dp} sequences from channel, but got {total_result_len}\"\n        )\n\n    @Worker.timer(\"training_step\")\n    def training_step(\n        self, batch: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | BatchResizingIterator\n    ) -> tuple[dict[str, torch.Tensor], float, list[float]]:\n        if isinstance(batch, dict):\n            global_batch_size = batch[\"input_ids\"].shape[0]\n            assert global_batch_size % self.micro_batch_size == 0, (\n                f\"global batch size {global_batch_size} can not divide micro_batch_size {self.micro_batch_size}\"\n            )\n            micro_batches_iter, micro_batch_cnt, _ = self._split_to_micro_batch(\n                batch,\n                self.enable_dynamic_batch_size,\n                max_tokens_per_mbs=self.max_tokens_per_mbs,\n                split_num=global_batch_size // self.micro_batch_size,\n            )\n            self.gradient_accumulation = micro_batch_cnt\n        else:\n            global_batch_size = self.total_batch_size_per_dp // self.n_mini_batches\n            micro_batch_cnt = global_batch_size // self.micro_batch_size\n            self.gradient_accumulation = micro_batch_cnt\n\n            def iterator_wrapper():\n                for _ in range(micro_batch_cnt):\n                    yield next(batch)\n\n            micro_batches_iter = iterator_wrapper()\n        self.optimizer.zero_grad()\n        mbs_metrics_list = {}\n        for idx, m_batch in enumerate(micro_batches_iter):\n            backward_ctx = self.before_micro_batch(\n                self.model,\n                is_last_micro_batch=(idx + 1) == micro_batch_cnt,\n            )\n            for k, v in m_batch.items():\n                m_batch[k] = (\n                    v.to(Worker.torch_device_type) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v\n                )\n\n            # batch for forward\n            logprobs, entropy = self.forward_batch(m_batch, True)\n\n            # batch for backward\n            # Prefer recomputed_logprobs (from actor inference), fallback to rollout_logprobs\n            old_logprobs = m_batch.get(\"recomputed_logprobs\")\n            if old_logprobs is None:\n                old_logprobs = m_batch[\"rollout_logprobs\"]\n            advantages = m_batch[\"advantages\"]\n            ref_logprobs = None\n            if \"ref_logprobs\" in m_batch:\n                ref_logprobs = m_batch[\"ref_logprobs\"]\n\n            loss_mask = m_batch[\"response_mask\"][:, -self.response_len :]\n\n            clip_ratio = self.cfg.algorithm.ratio_clip_eps\n            clip_ratio_low = self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"clip_ratio_low\", None)\n            clip_ratio_high = self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"clip_ratio_high\", None)\n            clip_ratio_low = (\n                clip_ratio_low if clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio\n            )\n            clip_ratio_high = (\n                clip_ratio_high if clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio\n            )\n            clip_ratio_c = self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"clip_ratio_c\", 3.0)\n\n            if self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"importance_sampling_fix\", False):\n                if (\n                    \"rollout_logprobs\" not in m_batch\n                    or \"recomputed_logprobs\" not in m_batch\n                ):\n                    raise ValueError(\n                        \"importance_sampling_fix requires both rollout_logprobs and recomputed_logprobs\"\n                    )\n                rollout_logprobs = m_batch[\"rollout_logprobs\"]\n                recomputed_logprobs = m_batch[\"recomputed_logprobs\"]\n                advantages = advantages * torch.clamp(\n                    (recomputed_logprobs - rollout_logprobs).exp(),\n                    max=self.cfg.algorithm.importance_sampling_clip,\n                )\n\n            loss, mbs_metrics_data = policy_loss(\n                task_type=self.task_type,\n                loss_type=self.cfg.algorithm.loss_type,\n                loss_agg_func=self.loss_agg_func,\n                logprobs=logprobs,\n                old_logprobs=old_logprobs,\n                advantages=advantages,\n                clip_ratio_c=clip_ratio_c,\n                clip_ratio_low=clip_ratio_low,\n                clip_ratio_high=clip_ratio_high,\n                loss_mask=loss_mask,\n                clip_log_ratio_min=self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"clip_log_ratio_min\", None),\n                clip_log_ratio_max=self.cfg.algorithm.get(\"clip_log_ratio_max\", None),\n                fast_path_zero_loss_mask=True,\n            )\n\n            entropy_loss = torch.tensor(\n                0.0, device=Worker.torch_platform.current_device()\n            )\n            if self.calculate_entropy:\n                entropy_loss = self.loss_agg_func(entropy, mask=loss_mask)\n                if self.calculate_entropy_loss:\n                    loss = loss - self.cfg.algorithm.entropy_bonus * entropy_loss\n\n            kl_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=Worker.torch_platform.current_device())\n            if self.kl_beta > 0 and ref_logprobs is not None:\n                kld = kl_penalty(ref_logprobs, logprobs, self.kl_penalty_type)\n                kl_loss = self.loss_agg_func(kld, loss_mask)\n                loss = loss + kl_loss * self.kl_beta\n\n            # add to log\n            # scale loss for gradient accumulation and backprop\n -1) -> torch.Tensor:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute entropy by logits,formula: H(X) = - sum(p(x) * log(p(x)))\n    In case logits are too small to cause numerical instability(like downflow to zero after 1).reshape(rewards.shape[1], -1)\n        reward_matrix = rewards.reshape(n_prompts, group_size, rewards.shape[-1])\n        reward_matrix = reward_matrix.sum(dim=-1)\n        mean_reward_in_group = reward_matrix.mean(dim=1)\n\n        reward_filter_mask = (mean_reward_in_group >= rewards_lower_bound) & (\n            mean_reward_in_group <= rewards_upper_bound\n        )\n        reward_filter_mask = reward_filter_mask.repeat_interleave(group_size)\n        reward_filter_mask = (\n            reward_filter_mask.unsqueeze(0).expand(n_chunk_step, -1).unsqueeze(-1)\n        )\n\n        if batch.get(\"loss_mask\", None) is not None:\n            batch[\"loss_mask\"] = reward_filter_mask & batch[\"loss_mask\"]\n        else:\n            batch[\"loss_mask\"] = reward_filter_mask\n\n    return batch\n"}
